description: Generate an image from a text prompt with the local Qwen-Image 2.1 model, optionally using reference images (a person, a product, a style) in a new scene. Write the full, detailed prompt yourself (see the prompt field): it is used as is. Dimensions are chosen automatically (aspect ratio can be inferred from the prompt, e.g. '16:9 hero image') unless width/height or aspect_ratio are given. Returns the absolute path of the saved PNG. Runs fully offline; typically 45 s–4 min.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio such as 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 16:9, 9:16, or auto (inferred from the prompt)

height.description: Output height in pixels (needs width too).

include_preview.description: Also return a small JPEG preview in the tool result. Default false: images stay local and are not sent to the model.

output_path.description: Optional destination (absolute, or relative to the project). Must be inside the project or the app output folder. Existing files are never overwritten; a numbered name is used instead.

prompt.description: The final prompt, written by you in English and used as is (Kokon does not rewrite it): one paragraph of about 60-200 words describing the finished image: medium and style first, the subject and what it does, the setting and background, composition and camera view, and the light. Copy any text to show exactly, in double quotes. No quality tags or sizes. With reference_images: refer to them as image 1, image 2..., say what to take from each (a person's face and look, a product with its shape, colours and logo, a style) and describe the new scene around them; never ask to keep a reference unchanged.

quality.description: All run Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (8 steps): fast = ~1 MP (the default, fastest); balanced = ~1.5K; quality = native 2K (slowest; edits share 2K with their references)

reference_images.description: Optional images the new image uses (a person, a product, a place, a style), in order; refer to them as image 1, image 2, ... in the prompt. The output is sized like any new image, not like the references. To change an image instead, use edit_image or edit_images.

seed.description: Seed for reproducible results; omit or -1 for random

width.description: Output width in pixels (needs height too). Omit to choose automatically.

name: generate_image
title: Generate image
